method.smoothing: Triangular widths 1, 3, and 7 within the focus sentence. Truncate and renormalize at its ends.
method.compatibility: Half the 75th percentile of the paired ordinary word-score gap per width sets a radius. For each context and word, use the widest estimate compatible with all narrower estimates.
method.score: Use the minimum of two contexts after subtracting the stronger four-word flank from each, with identical eight-word phrase geometry and the existing four-word core guard.
method.point: Strictly exceed the second-largest ordinary selection work maximum, with a unique top region.
method.gate: Within each held cohort, gain useful locations on at least two works across both generators, lose no unsmoothed useful location, and add at most one false ordinary work group.
